tools.name: sfi.capabilities
tools.description: What this server can answer: a capability map with example questions, persona question-paths (admin, developer, architect, release manager, support) naming the tools for each, the trust-tag glossary (confidence, provenance, completeness), and the recommended conversation pattern. No args.

tools.name: sfi.list_analyses
tools.description: Catalog of every analysis on this server, including the ones not in tools/list: name, one-line summary and category (core, search, what-if, documentation, live, cross-org, industries). Use it to find a tool that is not listed, then sfi.describe_analysis for its args and sfi.run_analysis to run it.

tools.name: sfi.describe_analysis
tools.description: Summary, arg signature and JSON input schema for one analysis, by `name` (with or without the `sfi.` prefix). Call it before sfi.run_analysis when a tool's args are unclear.

tools.name: sfi.run_analysis
tools.description: Runs any analysis by `name` with `args` (an object; a JSON string of one is also accepted). Output is identical to calling the tool directly.

tools.name: sfi.route_question
tools.description: Advisory router for a vague, broad or compound question. It does not answer the question.

tools.name: sfi.org_card
tools.description: Orientation snapshot of the org, precomputed at refresh (16KB max, one file read): name, edition, sandbox or production, org id, admin contact, last refresh time, coverage and blind spots, scale by type, top objects, automation density, permission posture, integration surface and naming conventions.

tools.name: sfi.guidance
tools.description: General Salesforce best-practice guidance that is NOT about this org: Flow vs Apex, order of execution, governor limits, async Apex, trigger frameworks, bulkification, testing, OWD and sharing, profiles vs permission sets, packaging, sandboxes. Returns a curated summary with links to official docs.

tools.name: sfi.disambiguate_concepts
tools.description: Vocabulary + semantic-disambiguation tier - the 'is `Status` the same as `Stage` here?' surface.

tools.name: sfi.search_components
tools.description: Lexical (substring) search over component api names, labels and stored properties, including formula text such as ValidationRule errorConditionFormula. Use it when you know a word or snippet to look for.

tools.name: sfi.resolve
tools.description: Turns an informal or misspelled name into canonical-id candidates with a disposition: exact | ambiguous | none.

tools.name: sfi.get_component
tools.description: Fetches one component's definition by canonical id. Pass `id` (or `componentId`) in Type:ApiName form: CustomObject:Account, CustomField:Account.Industry__c, ApexClass:OrderService, Flow:Lead_Intake.

tools.name: sfi.list_components
tools.description: Inventory: lists components of one `type` (see enum), paged in id order. Narrow to one object with `objectApiName` (for example "Contact"; aliases object/objectId) or to any parent with `parentId` (for example "CustomObject:Contact"); the narrow applied is echoed in `appliedScope`.

tools.name: sfi.query_graph
tools.description: ADVANCED / power-user: a read-only, guard-railed STRUCTURED query over the vault's dependency graph, for ad-hoc questions the purpose-built tools don't cover (e.g. "every ApexClass whose api name starts with Billing", "all grantedBy edges of heuristic confidence", "nodes with no lastModifiedBy").

tools.name: sfi.search_apex_source
tools.description: Search the vaulted Apex source for matches. Optional regex; returns path, line, and snippet.

tools.name: sfi.search_flow_metadata
tools.description: Search the vaulted Flow metadata XML for matches. Optional regex; returns path, line, and snippet.

tools.name: sfi.lookup_record
tools.description: Given a CustomMetadataRecord or CustomSettingRecord canonical id (e.g., `CustomMetadataRecord:Marketo_Api_Setting__mdt.Default`), return the record's label, protected flag, parent type ApiName, and the full per-field value list.

tools.name: sfi.find_field_anywhere
tools.description: Universal-search surface - answers 'where is this field used anywhere in the org?' for one CustomField id, passed as `targetId` or its alias `fieldId` (field-tool-family parity).

tools.name: sfi.find_semantic_field
tools.description: Semantic-discovery surface - answers 'do we already have a field for X?'.

tools.name: sfi.lifecycle_process
tools.description: "What happens when {Object}.{field} becomes {value}?" - the existing process for a specific value or stage transition (which automations already run when a record moves into a given state, e.g. an Opportunity going to Closed Won or a Case status flip).

tools.name: sfi.explain_field
tools.description: Given a CustomField canonical id, return the field's label, description, type, required flag, and, `picklistValues`: the DECLARED value set from the field's inline value-set definition.

tools.name: sfi.compare_components
tools.description: Compare two live-graph components by canonical id, returning the structural diff.

tools.name: sfi.object_360
tools.description: "Tell me EVERYTHING about this OBJECT" - the object-tier counterpart to `field_360`, and the tool for "what is {Object} and what is attached to it", "what would I be touching if I changed/retired this object", "which profiles can create or edit it", "what reports and record pages use it".

tools.name: sfi.what_happens_on_save
tools.description: What already runs when a record of one object is saved, in Salesforce order of execution for one DML event.

tools.name: sfi.explain_flow
tools.description: Explain what a Flow does in plain business terms - what it is FOR, when it runs, and what it changes. The go-to answer for "what does this flow do", "what is this automation for", "walk me through this process", or "explain the {Name} flow".

tools.name: sfi.flow_graph
tools.description: The FAITHFUL structural graph of a Flow, and - with `walkthrough: true` - the ORDERED, element-by-element walk of what runs when it runs.

tools.name: sfi.flow_trace
tools.description: Honest PROJECTION of a Flow over a caller-supplied record state - the "what happens to THIS record" debugger.

tools.name: sfi.explain_apex_method
tools.description: Given an ApexClass or ApexTrigger canonical id (`ApexClass:{ClassName}` or `ApexTrigger:{TriggerName}`), return a structured narrative payload for the explainer.

tools.name: sfi.explain_formula
tools.description: Tokenize a Salesforce formula expression and return a structured narrative payload for the explainer.

tools.name: sfi.field_meaning
tools.description: Vocabulary + semantic-disambiguation tier - the 'what does this field actually mean in our org?' surface.

tools.name: sfi.field_provenance
tools.description: Vocabulary + semantic-disambiguation tier - the 'is this field manually entered or automated?' surface.

tools.name: sfi.field_360
tools.description: A complete 360 profile of a single FIELD - everything that touches that field across validation, formulas, automation, code, UI, integrations, and emails, in one place.

tools.name: sfi.explain_error
tools.description: Decode a PASTED Salesforce error string back to the org component that produced it - the support desk's first-line tool.

tools.name: sfi.explain_debug_log
tools.description: Decode a PASTED Apex DEBUG LOG, flow fault text, or governor-limit exception back to the org component that ran - the developer/support runtime-triage wedge, ZERO org access.

tools.name: sfi.trace_debug_log
tools.description: READ a pasted Apex DEBUG LOG as the EVENT STREAM it is, and answer the four questions a log is actually opened for: the execution TIMELINE, WHERE THE TIME WENT, WHICH AUTOMATION FIRED IN WHAT ORDER, and CONSUMPTION BY PHASE + the platform's own limit table. 100% OFFLINE.

tools.name: sfi.get_edges
tools.description: Raw graph edges touching one node.

tools.name: sfi.get_subgraph
tools.description: BFS from a root component, up to `hops` (max 3). Returns the connected node and edge slice, capped at 200 nodes / 400 edges and bounded again by a response-byte budget.

tools.name: sfi.get_impact
tools.description: Answers 'what breaks if I change or delete this?' by walking incoming dependency edges from one component.

tools.name: sfi.find_formula_references
tools.description: List the incoming `references` edges to a field with the source nodes and edge-level metadata (e.g., formula tokenizer properties).

tools.name: sfi.find_code_usages
tools.description: List the code source files (ApexClass, ApexTrigger, LightningComponentBundle, AuraDefinitionBundle, VisualforcePage, VisualforceComponent) that read, write, call, or reference a component.

tools.name: sfi.safe_to_delete_field
tools.description: Deletion verdict for one field, with the evidence.

tools.name: sfi.find_dependency_cycles
tools.description: Architect tool: find cyclic dependency clusters in the org's Apex.

tools.name: sfi.field_change_advisor
tools.description: Decision-support tool: before changing a field, see the whole blast radius in one briefing.

tools.name: sfi.what_if_change_field_value
tools.description: Value-change impact (Data Steward / Identity & Integration lens): given a CustomField `fieldId`, what breaks if its stored VALUE changes - NOT its schema (use what_if_change_field_type for type/required/delete).

tools.name: sfi.value_change_audit
tools.description: Batch value-change audit (Data Steward lens): given an `object` and optionally a list of `fields`, risk-ranks the impact of changing each field's stored VALUE - the portfolio version of what_if_change_field_value.

tools.name: sfi.why_field_changed
tools.description: Each writer carries the literal it sets or its source and `operation`; pass `value` to ask what sets the field to X: picklist values are checked against the value set, checkboxes take true/false, and `valueFilter` groups every writer into `definitelySets`, `maySet`, and `cannotSet`.

tools.name: sfi.record_delete_impact
tools.description: "If a record of this object is deleted, what happens to its children, and what stops it?" For an object: `children[]`, citing the field file and the `<deleteConstraint>` line.

tools.name: sfi.what_if_change_field_type
tools.description: Given a CustomField canonical id (`CustomField:{Object}.{Field}`) and a proposed new field type, returns the structured impact across every incoming dependency edge.

tools.name: sfi.what_if_remove_picklist_value
tools.description: Given a Picklist or MultiselectPicklist CustomField id and a value to remove, lists the components it can see using the value.

tools.name: sfi.what_if_make_field_required
tools.description: Given a CustomField id (`CustomField:{Object}.{Field}`), walks the parent object's write paths and flags incomplete writes that would fail at runtime once the field is required.

tools.name: sfi.what_if_deactivate_flow
tools.description: Given a Flow canonical id, bare API name, or flow label / partial name, enumerates the downstream impact of deactivating the Flow by walking every outgoing edge.

tools.name: sfi.what_if_disable_trigger
tools.description: Given an ApexTrigger canonical id (`ApexTrigger:{Name}`), enumerates the downstream impact of disabling the trigger by walking every outgoing edge.

tools.name: sfi.what_if_change_method_signature
tools.description: Given an ApexClass, a method name, and an optional new signature string, enumerates every direct caller of the named method plus every test class exercising the target class.

tools.name: sfi.what_if_merge_profiles
tools.description: Given two Profile canonical ids, walks both profiles' grants and visibility settings, groups them by `(settingType, settingId)`, and surfaces every pairwise disagreement as a `MergeConflict` carrying `profileAValue`, `profileBValue`, and a `recommendedPolicy`.

tools.name: sfi.what_if_split_profile
tools.description: Given a Profile id (`Profile:{Name}`) and an ordered array of target PermissionSet ids (`PermissionSet:{Name}`), proposes a per-grant assignment via a greedy keyword-match heuristic.

tools.name: sfi.downstream_effects
tools.description: Given an `ApexClass:`, `ApexTrigger:`, OR `CustomObject:` id, surfaces what downstream automation and side effects are reachable.

tools.name: sfi.review_change
tools.description: Is this deployment risky? Pre-deploy review of a change set - answers 'what could go wrong if I deploy this', 'what should I test before deploying', 'review my package.xml / PR / changeset'.

tools.name: sfi.package_impact
tools.description: Managed-package boundary surface - 'what does the {namespace} package touch, and what of MINE breaks if I uninstall/upgrade it?'.

tools.name: sfi.field_lineage
tools.description: Trace where a field's value comes from and what it feeds - its data provenance upstream (which automations, formulas, code, or integrations set it) and its downstream effects (what reads it, what fires because of it).

tools.name: sfi.find_component_usages
tools.description: The universal "where is this component used?" answer for ANY canonical component type (`componentId`) - one entry point instead of fanning out across find_field_anywhere / find_code_usages / get_impact / grep.

tools.name: sfi.synthesize_answer
tools.description: Grounding check before you answer. Pass the JSON output of earlier sfi.* calls as `input` (any JSON; combine several results in one array or object), optionally the user's `question`, and optionally your `draft` answer.

tools.name: sfi.interpret
tools.description: WHEN to reach for this: the user asks what a component structurally IMPLIES, or the CONSEQUENCES of a design.

tools.name: sfi.permission_risk_report
tools.description: Ranked permission-risk report, leading with OVER-PRIVILEGE read straight from the extracted profile / permission-set metadata.

tools.name: sfi.permission_set_consolidation
tools.description: Offline, vault-only CONSOLIDATION candidates for permission sets, from DECLARED grants - 'which permission sets are redundant / duplicate / consolidatable'.

tools.name: sfi.effective_permissions
tools.description: What a profile plus permission-set bundle actually GRANTS, unioned, with each permission attributed to the container that grants it: object CRUD and View/Modify All, field-security count, system permissions, custom permissions, Apex class access, record-type visibility, Visualforce pages and tabs.

tools.name: sfi.who_can_run
tools.description: The REVERSE of `sfi.user_ability`: given a `Flow:X` (`componentId`), which Profiles / PermissionSets grant RUN access to it (from the `flowAccess` `grantedBy` edges).

tools.name: sfi.who_can_access_object
tools.description: Reverse access lookup: which profiles, permission sets, roles and groups can reach records of one object, and how (org-wide default, object CRUD and View/Modify All, ViewAllData/ModifyAllData, sharing rules with groups expanded to members).

tools.name: sfi.guest_exposure_report
tools.description: "What can UNAUTHENTICATED GUEST users see in my Experience Cloud / Site communities?" - the audit for one of the most notorious real-world Salesforce leaks (over-permissioned site guest profiles exposing PII to the open internet).

tools.name: sfi.community_catalog
tools.description: "What Experience Cloud communities does this org have, and WHO CAN LOG INTO them?" - the OFFLINE metadata answer, one row per community, joining the `Network` (community definition) to the `CustomSite` (site container) it names through `<site>`.

tools.name: sfi.why_cant_user_see_record
tools.description: Explains whether a user can see, edit, delete or create records of an object, and why not.

tools.name: sfi.layout_for_user
tools.description: Walk the Salesforce layout-routing cascade for a given object, optional record type, and profile.

tools.name: sfi.user_ability
tools.description: "What can this Profile / PermissionSet RUN or DO?" - beyond record CRUD (which `object_access_audit` / `why_cant_user_see_record` cover).

tools.name: sfi.profile_security
tools.description: "What are this profile's login & session security policies?" - a focused security-audit surface separate from `user_ability` (which is "what can it RUN or DO").

tools.name: sfi.security_settings
tools.description: "What are my ORG-WIDE security settings - and what can this product NOT see?" One call over `settings/Security.settings-meta.xml` (root `<SecuritySettings>`), which produces two org-level singletons.

tools.name: sfi.lightning_pages
tools.description: Lightning record pages (FlexiPage), both directions.

tools.name: sfi.list_view_sharing
tools.description: "Who is this list view shared with?" - a list view's `<sharedTo>` visibility scope (the groups/roles it shows up for in the list-view picker), now captured at extraction as `visibleTo` edges.

tools.name: sfi.app_access
tools.description: Given a `CustomApplication`, return what's IN the app and WHO can use it: `navType`, `tabs`, `canOpen`, and `defaultedBy`.

tools.name: sfi.tab_availability
tools.description: Given a `Profile:X` or `PermissionSet:X`, list the tabs it can see: each row carries the `tab`, the verbatim `visibility` enum, and an `available` flag normalising 'the user can reach this tab'.

tools.name: sfi.layout_assignments
tools.description: The REVERSE of `sfi.layout_for_user`: enumerate every (Profile × RecordType) assignment that targets a page layout - the question an admin asks before editing or deleting a layout.

tools.name: sfi.field_access_audit
tools.description: Who can read or edit one FIELD: every Profile and PermissionSet that grants field-level security on it, plus Apex classes that read or write it (an indirect path).

tools.name: sfi.object_access_audit
tools.description: Given a CustomObject canonical id (`CustomObject:{ApiName}`), enumerate every Profile and PermissionSet that grants OBJECT-level access via incoming `grantedBy` edges.

tools.name: sfi.recordtype_availability
tools.description: Given a Profile or PermissionSet canonical id, report which record types the user can CREATE / see, grouped by object, from the granter's `recordTypeVisibilities`.

tools.name: sfi.persona_unused_grants
tools.description: Which object and field permissions does this kind of user have that nothing they can run uses?

tools.name: sfi.how_to_see
tools.description: The exact click path a reviewer follows to open a component - the "How to see it" steps of a finding, worded with the vault's labels.

tools.name: sfi.unassigned_permission_sets
tools.description: List PermissionSets unassigned to users.

tools.name: sfi.crud_fls_audit
tools.description: CRUD/FLS enforcement audit.

tools.name: sfi.what_if_assign_permset
tools.description: Permission-set what-if tool: given a target permission set and a `baseline` container set, returns the NET access the user would GAIN by assigning the target.

tools.name: sfi.what_if_revoke_permset
tools.description: Permission-set what-if tool: given a target permission set and a `baseline` container set, returns the NET access the user would LOSE by revoking the target.

tools.name: sfi.generate_sharing_summary
tools.description: Composes a structured markdown sharing summary covering every CustomObject's OWD, the SharingRules that apply, the Profile / PermissionSet grants tallied from incoming `grantedBy` edges on the object, and the Role Hierarchy.

tools.name: sfi.automation_risk_report
tools.description: Ranked automation risks: Process Builder migration candidates and governor-limit findings.

tools.name: sfi.action_chain
tools.description: "What actually happens when I convert this Lead / submit this record for approval?" - a record ACTION composed as a CHAIN, the way `order_of_execution` composes a record SAVE.

tools.name: sfi.apex_test_coverage
tools.description: Developer tool: map test-class references to the Apex they exercise. With `classApiName`, returns the test classes that reach it (`target.coveringTests`; `coveringTestDetail` gives depth and `via`: direct / transitive / via-trigger) and a `status` of has-test-references / no-test-references-found.

tools.name: sfi.automation_build_advisor
tools.description: Decision-support tool: before an admin/architect builds automation on an object, brief them on what already runs there and the org-specific risks of adding more.

tools.name: sfi.automation_collisions
tools.description: Field-level write-collision + save-recursion cycle detector for ONE object - 'is my org fighting itself on this object?'. Where automation_build_advisor flags OBJECT-level hazards (multiple flows, mixed paradigms), this tool looks at what those automations actually WRITE.

tools.name: sfi.apex_build_advisor
tools.description: Decision-support tool: before a developer writes Apex, brief them on what the org's existing Apex teaches.

tools.name: sfi.order_of_execution
tools.description: Full order-of-execution map for one object across every DML event (insert, update, delete, undelete): the same per-phase steps as sfi.what_happens_on_save, keyed by event in `byEvent`.

tools.name: sfi.record_creation_paths
tools.description: "How do records of this object get created?" - the record-provenance trace an admin needs to answer "how did this record get here?".

tools.name: sfi.nonselective_soql
tools.description: Flag NON-SELECTIVE SOQL - a WHERE clause with a full-table-scan / timeout shape at large data volume.

tools.name: sfi.flow_bulkification_audit
tools.description: Flag Flows that perform a record Create / Update / Delete or a Get Records lookup INSIDE a Loop body, plus filterless Get Records anywhere - the Flow-side complement of `sfi.governor_limit_risks`, which scans only ApexClass / ApexTrigger source and never sees Flows.

tools.name: sfi.flow_fault_audit
tools.description: Which Flows have a DML/action element with NO fault path - the flow error-handling hygiene sweep.

tools.name: sfi.apex_structure
tools.description: The PARSED anatomy of ONE Apex class or trigger, plus the review a senior reviewer would give it - the Apex counterpart of `sfi.flow_graph(walkthrough)`.

tools.name: sfi.process_builder_migration_candidates
tools.description: List active Process Builder (Flow with `processType: 'Workflow'`), WorkflowRule, and ApprovalProcess nodes as migration candidates with per-rule complexity ('simple' / 'moderate' / 'complex') and a migration-notes paragraph.

tools.name: sfi.code_quality_audit
tools.description: General-purpose code-quality entry point.

tools.name: sfi.governor_limit_risks
tools.description: Apex-specific narrowing for governor-limit-relevant patterns - the performance/scale subset of the quality catalog.

tools.name: sfi.find_hardcoded_values
tools.description: 'find me hardcoded IDs / emails / usernames / endpoint URLs / sandbox-test-data' surface.

tools.name: sfi.test_coverage_gaps
tools.description: `properties.isTest === true` identifies test classes, BFS over incoming callsApex / dispatchesAsync / inheritsFrom / references edges from Apex, plus a trigger hop for a test whose DML fires a trigger that reaches the class.

tools.name: sfi.call_graph
tools.description: Deep code tool: given a root `ApexClass:` or `ApexTrigger:` id and an optional `direction` (`'downstream' | 'upstream' | 'both'`; defaults to `'both'`), BFS over `callsApex` edges up to `maxDepth` hops (default 3, max 5).

tools.name: sfi.test_coverage_for_method
tools.description: Deep code tool: given an `ApexClass:` or `ApexTrigger:` id and an optional `methodName`, walks upstream `callsApex` + `dispatchesAsync` BFS and surfaces every test class that reaches the target.

tools.name: sfi.meaningful_test_audit
tools.description: Lists every ApexClass with `properties.isTest === true` with a heuristic assertion-meaningfulness score.

tools.name: sfi.method_reachability
tools.description: Given an ApexClass / ApexTrigger, walks upstream USAGE-edge BFS and classifies the reachable upstream set against the entry-point taxonomy.

tools.name: sfi.tests_for_change
tools.description: Smart test selection: given `changedComponents`, returns the MINIMAL set of test classes to run plus the inverse risk signal - changed components no test reaches.

tools.name: sfi.async_chain_depth
tools.description: Given an ApexClass canonical id (`ApexClass:{Name}`), walks the transitive async chain via outgoing `dispatchesAsync` edges, capped at 10 hops.

tools.name: sfi.scheduled_job_catalog
tools.description: Returns one entry per ApexClass with `properties.isSchedulable === true`, with the per-class `scheduledByCalls` array surfaced from inbound `dispatchesAsync` edges whose `properties.dispatchMechanism === 'schedule'`.

tools.name: sfi.find_hardcoded_values_anywhere
tools.description: Cross-corpus hardcoded-value surface - extends `sfi.find_hardcoded_values` (Apex-only) with formula expressions (CustomField.formula), ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula, and WorkflowRule.formula.

tools.name: sfi.find_clone_patterns
tools.description: Structural clone-detection surface. TWO modes.

tools.name: sfi.find_dead_code
tools.description: Cross-cutting dead-code surface - composes `method_reachability` verdict, entry-point taxonomy, and zero-usage detection into a single cascade verdict per candidate: `definitely_dead`, `likely_dead`, `uncertain`.

tools.name: sfi.integration_map
tools.description: Return a structured topology of the org's integration surfaces: AuthProviders, NamedCredentials, RemoteSiteSettings, CspTrustedSites, ExternalDataSources, ExternalServices, ConnectedApps, NetworkAccess entries, plus the cross-type `references` edges connecting them.

tools.name: sfi.event_subscribers
tools.description: DETAIL VIEW for ONE Platform Event.

tools.name: sfi.event_topology
tools.description: The org's EVENT PLANE in one call - Platform Events, Change Data Capture, and the channels that carry both, with inventory AND where-used.

tools.name: sfi.outbound_message_catalog
tools.description: Returns one entry per OutboundMessage node with the endpoint URL, payload shape, integration user, the includeSessionId / useDeadLetterQueue flags, and the WorkflowRules that invoke it via incoming `references` edges.

tools.name: sfi.endpoint_catalog
tools.description: Returns every URL / endpoint participating in an integration in one structured response, split four ways - `inboundApis`, `apexCallouts`, `outboundMessages`, `externalDataSources`, and `namedCredentials`.

tools.name: sfi.installed_package_catalog
tools.description: Answer "what packages are installed in this org?" from the `InstalledPackage` metadata the refresh extracts (`installedPackages/<namespace>.installedPackage-meta.xml`).

tools.name: sfi.generate_fleet_report
tools.description: The "state of my orgs" digest: ONE GeneratedDocument composed across EVERY vault in the multi-vault registry, so you get a single artifact instead of running sfi.org_pulse / sfi.fleet_find / sfi.fleet_drift_ranking once per org by hand.

tools.name: sfi.get_naming_convention_report
tools.description: Return the naming-convention pattern observations, optionally scoped to one object (`scope: 'CustomField:{Object}'` or `'CustomField:{Object}.*'`; omit or pass `'all'` for org-wide).

tools.name: sfi.export_manifest
tools.description: Group a set of canonical component ids into a well-formed `package.xml` snippet a human can hand to Gearset / Copado / `sf project deploy`.

tools.name: sfi.org_overview
tools.description: Org tour computed from the graph: counts per component type, top 10 objects by inbound dependencies, top Apex classes by callers, broadest profiles, integration surface, automation summary with active ratio, front-end mix, legacy-debt indicators, largest classes and naming conventions.

tools.name: sfi.domain_clusters
tools.description: Cluster the org's CustomObject + ApexClass + Flow nodes into SUGGESTED domain groupings using a greedy shared-edge-density algorithm.

tools.name: sfi.generate_data_dictionary
tools.description: Given a CustomObject, composes a structured markdown document covering the object's Overview, Fields, Relationships, Validation Rules, Page Layouts, and Related Triggers/Flows.

tools.name: sfi.generate_admin_handbook
tools.description: Composes a structured markdown admin handbook covering the org's purpose, main objects, automation summary, permission structure, integration topology, and recent changes.

tools.name: sfi.generate_architecture_overview
tools.description: Composes a 3-4 page architecture document chaining `sfi.org_overview` + `sfi.domain_clusters` + `sfi.integration_map`.

tools.name: sfi.generate_compliance_report
tools.description: Composes a structured markdown compliance report chaining `sfi.pii_inventory` + `sfi.field_access_audit` (per regulated field on the current PAGE - default 25, adjustable via limit/offset/cursor) + per-object `sharingModel` lookup.

tools.name: sfi.generate_onboarding_doc
tools.description: ORG-WIDE only - to document ONE object for a new hire use `sfi.object_360` with `format: "handbook"`.

tools.name: sfi.field_mapping_between_objects
tools.description: Map the fields of one object onto another for a conversion or migration - which field on object A corresponds to which field on object B, and which fields have no match and would lose data.

tools.name: sfi.org_pulse
tools.description: Org pulse for the current vault: freshness coverage (how many components carry a known lastModifiedDate, the coverage %, and the oldest/newest components) plus the top contributors by lastModifiedBy. Answers "how fresh is what I know about this org?" and "who shaped this org?".

tools.name: sfi.doc_coverage_report
tools.description: Offline, vault-only documentation-GAP meter - the documentation axis `sfi.tech_debt_score` lacks. MEASURES where the org's metadata is undocumented (it does NOT PRODUCE docs like `sfi.generate_data_dictionary` / `sfi.generate_admin_handbook`).

tools.name: sfi.limit_headroom_report
tools.description: Offline, vault-only limit-headroom report - the replacement for the retiring Salesforce Optimizer's limit report. Counts the org's METADATA against per-object and per-org CONFIGURATION ceilings and ranks the rows WORST-FIRST by remaining headroom% so an admin acts before a deploy hits a wall.

tools.name: sfi.get_manifest
tools.description: Return the current vault manifest (org-kb/meta/manifest.json) verbatim.

tools.name: sfi.coverage_report
tools.description: Report the vault's self-assessed metadata coverage: covered, partial, not-modeled, and - during a staged refresh - pending families (queued by the in-progress tiered build, with `stagedBuild` tier progress; pending types count as missing coverage, so absence answers about them must stay qualified).

tools.name: sfi.retrieve_blindspot_report
tools.description: Retrieve blind spots: components REFERENCED by retrieved automation / code / config but ABSENT from the vault (their edge targets resolve to no node). The honest backing for absence answers: an 'X is unused / nothing references X / X is safe to delete' answer about a listed target is unreliable.

tools.name: sfi.health_check
tools.description: Vault health: status, coverage completeness by type, freshness (vault age, stale flag, changes in the last refresh), staged-refresh progress and vault-history status. No args.

tools.name: sfi.baseline_acknowledge
tools.description: Acknowledge a heuristic finding so SAST tools suppress it across refreshes (stored in org-kb/meta/baseline.json).

tools.name: sfi.baseline_status
tools.description: List suppressed finding fingerprints and per-tool counts from the vault baseline file.

tools.name: sfi.org_risk_report
tools.description: Deterministic org risk synthesis: health, tech debt, over-privilege (standard profiles ranked below custom grantors), guest-user exposure, PII and coverage gaps ranked with trust metadata.

tools.name: sfi.unused_components
tools.description: Find UNUSED / DEAD components - Apex classes that are never called, flows that are deployed but never run, permission sets nobody uses, email templates nobody sends, fields nothing reads.

tools.name: sfi.ai_exposure_report
tools.description: AI-exposure audit (the flagship): 'what data can my org's own AI see?'.

tools.name: sfi.what_changed_since_refresh
tools.description: 'since my last refresh, which component TYPES changed?'. Reads the continuous-learning store's MOST RECENT refresh entry and returns the non-zero per-type `changedTypes` (signed: + added / − removed), `changedTypeCount`, `changedEdges`, `lastRefreshedAt`, and a plain-language `interpretation`.

tools.name: sfi.org_history
tools.description: Refresh timeline of this vault: per-refresh component and edge changes by type, most recent first, plus refreshCount, first and last refresh time and net component change. Use it for 'how has the org changed over time'.

tools.name: sfi.diff_snapshots
tools.description: Compare two captured vault snapshots and report the structural diff. `fromLabel` and `toLabel` name persisted snapshots under `{vaultRoot}/snapshots/`; the special value `'current'` for `toLabel` triggers a transient capture of the live graph (no persisted artefact).

tools.name: sfi.trend
tools.description: Timeline of persisted snapshot captures. Default (no `metric`): component/edge counts per label.

tools.name: sfi.pii_inventory
tools.description: Enumerate every CustomField in the vault, classify each with the `pii-detection` recognizer (which inspects API name, declared data type, and description text), then emit a structured inventory.

tools.name: sfi.changed_since
tools.description: Enumerate every vault node whose `lastModifiedDate` is at or after `since`.

tools.name: sfi.last_modified
tools.description: Given a canonical componentId (e.g., `ApexClass:AccountController`, `CustomField:Account.Industry`, `Flow:Lead_Nurture`), return the component's freshness fields: `lastModifiedDate` (ISO 8601 or null), `lastModifiedBy: { id, name }` (or null), and `apiVersion` (number or null).

tools.name: sfi.unused_fields_deep
tools.description: Optional `objectId` narrows the scan to one CustomObject - accepts the canonical id (`CustomObject:Account`) or a bare api name (`Account`), matched case-insensitively against the vault and echoed back as `appliedScope`; without it the scan is org-wide.

tools.name: sfi.empty_queues_and_groups
tools.description: List Queue and Group nodes with zero members, and say which of those zeros were actually MEASURED.

tools.name: sfi.tech_debt_score
tools.description: Aggregate the unused_components, unused_fields_deep / process_builder_migration_candidates / unassigned_permission_sets / empty_queues_and_groups, qualityIssues data, freshness data, and the Apex API-version distribution into one weighted 0-100 score plus a category breakdown.

tools.name: sfi.picklist_integrity_scan
tools.description: Org-wide picklist value-set integrity scan - the INVERSE of what_if_remove_picklist_value (which starts from one value).

tools.name: sfi.annotations
tools.description: Read the curated annotations overlay (`meta/annotations.jsonl`): ownership, lifecycle status (e.g. deprecated), glossary synonyms, domain grouping, and notes that humans stated - or AI proposed and a human confirmed - about org components.

tools.name: sfi.propose_annotation
tools.description: Record an AI-PROPOSED annotation (owner / status / glossary / domain / note) for a component. Written ALWAYS as `source: 'ai', confirmed: false` - confirmation is a human act via `sfi.confirm_annotation` (or CLI `sfi annotate confirm <id> <key>`); discard with `sfi.reject_annotation`.

tools.name: sfi.review_annotations
tools.description: List UNCONFIRMED annotation proposals from `meta/annotations.jsonl` (AI proposals awaiting human sign-off). Optional `componentId` / `key` / `author` filters.

tools.name: sfi.confirm_annotation
tools.description: Confirm an AI-proposed annotation: re-writes the existing (componentId, key) value as `source: 'human', confirmed: true` - the same write as CLI `sfi annotate confirm <componentId> <key>`. Idempotent when already confirmed.

tools.name: sfi.reject_annotation
tools.description: Reject (discard) an UNCONFIRMED annotation proposal by writing `op: 'unset'` for the (componentId, key) pair - dedicated reject verb wrapping CLI `sfi annotate <id> --key <k> --unset`. Refuses already-confirmed entries (those are curated facts; remove them via the CLI unset path).

tools.name: sfi.component_history
tools.description: The component's change timeline from the vault's OWN git history: `git log --follow` over its source file, merged with the org-declared metadata lastModified stamps; optional capped unified diff of the most recent change.

tools.name: sfi.component_change_attribution
tools.description: Who changed this component in Setup, and when - OFFLINE, from persisted SetupAuditTrail rows (`meta/setup-audit-trail.jsonl` written by `sfi refresh --with-audit-trail`).

tools.name: sfi.component_as_of
tools.description: The component AS IT WAS at a git ref in the vault's own history: `git show <ref>:<sourcePath>` re-run through the SAME extractor the refresh uses for that type → declared properties-as-of (apiName/label/type + extractor properties).

tools.name: sfi.history_tracking_gaps
tools.description: Compliance audit: 'which sensitive fields have no field-history tracking enabled?'.

tools.name: sfi.live_describe
tools.description: Opt-in live org: describe an sObject via Salesforce CLI. Disabled unless SFI_LIVE_PLANE_ENABLED=1 or liveEnabled=true.

tools.name: sfi.live_stale_check
tools.description: Opt-in live org: "is the org AHEAD of the vault?".

tools.name: sfi.live_count
tools.description: Opt-in live org: count records. Pass `objectApiName` to count every row of an object, or `soql` for a custom count query.

tools.name: sfi.live_sample
tools.description: Opt-in live org: run SOQL with a hard row cap (default + max 200). Read-only sample rows for runtime questions.

tools.name: sfi.live_field_population
tools.description: Opt-in live org: population rate for one field (total vs null counts).

tools.name: sfi.live_group_count
tools.description: Opt-in live org: value distribution - COUNT grouped by one field on any object (e.g. Cases by Status, Accounts by Industry). Optional equality filter.

tools.name: sfi.live_stale_records
tools.description: Opt-in live org: records on any object not touched in N days (default LastModifiedDate). Answers "which X are stale/unused?" without arbitrary SOQL.

tools.name: sfi.live_recent_activity
tools.description: Opt-in live org: records created or modified in the last N days on any object. Read-only; capped detail with true total.

tools.name: sfi.live_aggregate
tools.description: Opt-in live org: MIN/MAX/AVG/SUM on one numeric field for any object. Optional equality filter.

tools.name: sfi.live_duplicate_check
tools.description: Opt-in live org: find duplicate values on one field (GROUP BY + HAVING COUNT > 1). Read-only; capped duplicate groups.

tools.name: sfi.live_owner_breakdown
tools.description: Opt-in live org: record counts by OwnerId with User/Queue names resolved. Read-only; top owners by volume.

tools.name: sfi.live_record_access
tools.description: Opt-in live org: a specific user's EFFECTIVE access to ONE record right now - Read / Edit / Delete / Transfer / Full (All) - from the org's live sharing calculation (UserRecordAccess).

tools.name: sfi.live_access_oracle
tools.description: Opt-in live org: PARITY ORACLE for the offline permission engine.

tools.name: sfi.live_record_shares
tools.description: Opt-in live org: the explicit sharing rows on ONE record - WHO it is shared with and WHY - from the runtime `{Object}Share` table (each row is a UserOrGroupId + AccessLevel + RowCause: Owner / Manual / a sharing Rule / a Team / Apex managed sharing).

tools.name: sfi.live_scheduled_jobs
tools.description: Opt-in live org: the RUNTIME schedule registry - what is ACTUALLY scheduled right now - from CronTrigger (+ CronJobDetail.Name / JobType, State, CronExpression, NextFireTime, TimesTriggered), plus an optional recent AsyncApexJob status summary.

tools.name: sfi.live_field_history
tools.description: Opt-in live org: WHO changed a field on a record and to what - from the `{Object}History` table (Field, OldValue, NewValue, CreatedBy.Name, CreatedDate). Filter by `fieldApiName`, `recordId`, and/or `days`.

tools.name: sfi.live_storage_by_object
tools.description: Opt-in live org: record counts across objects via the Salesforce recordCount REST API - top N by volume, optional objectApiNames filter. Read-only.

tools.name: sfi.live_org_limits
tools.description: Opt-in live org: current org governor limits via REST. Read-only.

tools.name: sfi.live_data_skew
tools.description: Opt-in live org: ownership / data-skew concentration - which `ownerField` value (default `OwnerId`) holds MORE than `threshold` records (default 10,000) of `objectApiName`, via a single `GROUP BY ... HAVING COUNT(Id) > threshold` SOQL aggregate, worst-concentration first.

tools.name: sfi.live_security_exposure
tools.description: Opt-in live org: the RUNTIME security-exposure snapshot, via resilient SOQL COUNT over PermissionSet / PermissionSetAssignment.

tools.name: sfi.live_inactive_users
tools.description: Opt-in live org: active users who haven't logged in within N days (default 30) or never have - the license-reclamation / dormant-account question. Standard (human) users by default; reports the true total (`totalInactive`) plus a capped detail page, oldest-dormant first.

tools.name: sfi.live_permset_holders
tools.description: Opt-in live org: WHO HOLDS a permission set, permission set group, or profile - the name-by-name assignment roster (PermissionSetAssignment / User rows are runtime state, never in the vault; vault sfi.effective_permissions describes what a grantor GRANTS, not who holds it).

tools.name: sfi.live_zombie_accounts
tools.description: Opt-in live org: ZOMBIE accounts - active users with login access but ZERO permission-set/PSG assignments, via a single SOQL anti-join.

tools.name: sfi.live_group_members
tools.description: Opt-in live org: WHO IS IN a queue or public group - the runtime GroupMember roster (metadata XML only carries DECLARED members, so the vault's member counts routinely say 0 while Setup-managed membership is live-only; vault sfi.empty_queues_and_groups reads the declared counts).

tools.name: sfi.live_user_permsets
tools.description: Opt-in live org: WHAT does USER X hold - the reverse of sfi.live_permset_holders (input = a user, output = the grantors they hold: profile + direct permission sets + permission set groups, with expirations).

tools.name: sfi.live_setup_audit_trail
tools.description: Opt-in live org: WHO CHANGED WHAT in Setup - the SetupAuditTrail roster (profile/permission-set edits, field changes, org-wide-default flips, and every other tracked configuration change), the runtime "who touched this" question the vault's declared metadata cannot answer.

tools.name: sfi.live_license_usage
tools.description: Opt-in live org: license / cost optimization.

tools.name: sfi.live_consent
tools.description: Reports, grants or revokes the per-org live-plane grant. The live plane runs read-only queries against the real org for record counts, samples and field population.

tools.name: sfi.live_report_usage
tools.description: Opt-in live org: stale/unused reports via Report.LastRunDate - total vs not-run-in-N-days. Read-only; resilient when Report is unavailable.

tools.name: sfi.live_folder_access
tools.description: Opt-in live org: folder inventory and access types (Report/Dashboard/Email/Document). Read-only; flags publicly accessible folders.

tools.name: sfi.live_email_template_usage
tools.description: Opt-in live org: email template usage, Classic vs Lightning classification, and migration candidates. Read-only.

tools.name: sfi.live_org_health
tools.description: Opt-in live org: operational health snapshot - failed/pending async jobs, paused flow interviews, governor limits at risk. Read-only.

tools.name: sfi.live_automation_fired
tools.description: Does this record-triggered automation actually run in production?

tools.name: sfi.live_picklist_usage
tools.description: Which picklist VALUES are actually used in production.

tools.name: sfi.live_budget
tools.description: Disclose this session's live-query budget and result-cache state.

tools.name: sfi.blast_radius_live
tools.description: Fuse the static impact graph with LIVE record magnitude - "what breaks if I change/remove X, and how much is at stake?".

tools.name: sfi.live_drift_check
tools.description: Offline↔live contradiction detection (requires the opt-in live plane).

tools.name: sfi.live_verify
tools.description: Confirm ONE claim against the live org now, with the smallest read-only query that can, so a finding never rests on a stale snapshot.

tools.name: sfi.cpq_rule_chain
tools.description: Given a CpqProductRule or CpqPriceRule canonical id, returns the chain of rules of the same type sharing the same parent CustomObject (the SBQQ__ rule object definition), sorted by `(active DESC, evaluationOrder ASC, id ASC)`.

tools.name: sfi.cpq_quote_template_breakdown
tools.description: Given a CpqQuoteTemplate canonical id, returns the template's top-level configuration plus a best-effort `sections` list derived from values whose `field` token begins with `SBQQ__Section__c`.

tools.name: sfi.cpq_dependency_map
tools.description: Walks the values mirror of every requested CPQ-typed node and surfaces every string-encoded `SBQQ__`-prefixed field reference as a heuristic dependency entry.

tools.name: sfi.datatransform_field_map
tools.description: Given an OmniDataTransform canonical id (`OmniDataTransform:{Name}_{VersionNumber}`), returns the DataRaptor's source-to-target field mapping plus the operation-type metadata (Extract / Load / Transform).

tools.name: sfi.decision_table_browse
tools.description: Given a DecisionTable canonical id, returns the table's parameter shape, and ALWAYS sets `rows: null`. will NOT enumerate row content; row data lives in the CSV uploaded to Salesforce Files, in the `sourceObject` SObject records, or in the OmniStudio designer's row-editor UI.

tools.name: sfi.integration_procedure_chain
tools.description: Given an OmniIntegrationProcedure canonical id, returns the IP's identity metadata and its steps, in runtime order, each with `name`, `type`, `description`, `sequenceNumber`, `isActive`, `executionConditionalFormula`, `path` / `depth`, and the element catalog's `canonicalType` and `role`.

tools.name: sfi.omniscript_flow
tools.description: Given an OmniScript canonical id, returns the parsed step sequence, the downstream IP / DataRaptor / sibling-OmniScript dispatches resolved through `dispatchesOmniAction` outgoing edges, and the OmniScript's identity metadata sourced from the R2 extractor's node properties.

tools.name: sfi.omniuicard_widget_breakdown
tools.description: Given an OmniUiCard canonical id, returns the FlexCard's identity metadata, the parsed `states[]` array each carrying `name`, `stateIndex`, recursive `widgetCount`, and the full recursive `widgets[]` tree, the declared `dataSource`.

tools.name: sfi.omni_model
tools.description: The inside of ONE OmniStudio component as nodes and edges: an OmniScript's elements, the data keys they produce and read, the server calls they make and the Integration Procedure input keys those fill, Edit Block delete paths; an Integration Procedure's steps in execution order.

tools.name: sfi.omni_dead_references
tools.description: Does every show rule, merge field and payload key in an OmniScript / Integration Procedure point at something that exists in the version that RUNS?

tools.name: sfi.omni_version_diff
tools.description: What changed between two versions of one OmniScript or Integration Procedure: elements added, removed and RENAMED, plus changes to behaviour-relevant settings.

tools.name: sfi.omni_edit_block_audit
tools.description: Audit every Edit Block of an OmniScript's active version - or of every active OmniScript: which server delete is wired, whether each delete IP is in the vault, where the deleted record's id comes from, and whether an edited card keeps its record.

tools.name: sfi.omni_completion_audit
tools.description: Does "Complete" mean "saved"?

tools.name: sfi.omni_form_spec
tools.description: The form a browser test runner fills, from metadata: for an OmniScript's active version, every step and its inputs, and a `sampleValue` that satisfies them.

tools.name: sfi.omni_path_simulator
tools.description: Given answers (a data JSON or flat name → value pairs), which steps and inputs of an OmniScript's active version are shown? Show rules are evaluated three-valued - a rule over an answer you did not supply is `unknown` and named in `unknownBecause`, never guessed.

tools.name: sfi.omni_changed_since
tools.description: What changed in OmniStudio since a previous refresh - semantically, so a finding whose evidence changed can be re-checked before it goes out. Compares a refresh snapshot (`snapshot` label from `sfi snapshot list`; default: the previous refresh) with the current vault.

tools.name: sfi.omni_prefill_trace
tools.description: For every answer an OmniScript screen saves: does the saved value come BACK when the screen reopens?

tools.name: sfi.omni_save_trace
tools.description: For every answer on an OmniScript screen: is it SAVED to the database, and if not, where exactly is it dropped? Judges the ACTIVE version (an inactive version or a `Type/SubType/Language` / unique-name selector is redirected to the active one and echoed in `appliedScope`).

tools.name: sfi.fleet_find
tools.description: Cross-vault resolve: which of your REGISTERED orgs contains the thing you mean. Runs the typo-tolerant resolver across every vault in the multi-vault registry, read-only, and reports per-vault dispositions (exact|ambiguous|none|unavailable) + which vaults it was found in.

tools.name: sfi.fleet_drift_ranking
tools.description: Fleet ops: of every REGISTERED vault, which is most behind its live org - i.e. which to /sfi-refresh first.

tools.name: sfi.compare_vaults
tools.description: Given two registered vault aliases, returns a structured diff identifying `added` (in B only), `removed` (in A only), and `shapeModified` (in both with at least one non-volatile property differing) components.

tools.name: sfi.promotion_readiness
tools.description: Promotion readiness: a focused lens on compare_vaults(sandbox → prod).

tools.name: sfi.compare_object_across_vaults
tools.description: Given a CustomObject api-name and two registered vault aliases, returns the field-by-field diff, plus `objectLevelDrift` for CustomObject-level property differences.

tools.name: sfi.compare_profile_across_vaults
tools.description: Given a Profile name and two registered vault aliases, returns per-grant-category drift - `grantDiffs.objectPermissions`, `.fieldPermissions`, `.tabVisibilities`, `.apexClassAccesses`, `.userPermissions`. Each `GrantDiff` carries `targetId`, `side` (`'A' | 'B' | 'both'`), `valueA`, `valueB`.
